FAQs

Roofing Questions, Answered

What people ask before they ring, answered by Lewis and the team.

About Us The Work Where We Work Getting a Quote

About Us

Who runs Stormwise Roofing and Building?

Lewis Birchall. There's a team of six of us. More about us.

How long have you been in business?

8 years.

Do you give a guarantee?

Yes, a 5 year guarantee. Ask us what it covers for your job when we quote.

The Work

What work do you do?

New roofs and re-roofs, roof repairs, flat roofs, uPVC fascias, soffits and gutters, storm damage, and repointing and roof cleaning. See all our services.

Do you do flat roofs?

Yes, flat roofs are one of our main services. Flat roofs.

Can you help after storm damage?

Yes. If wind has lifted, cracked or blown slates or tiles off your roof, call or WhatsApp us on 07734 356942 and tell us what you can see. Storm damage.

Do you replace fascias, soffits and gutters?

Yes, in uPVC. Fascias, soffits and gutters.

Do you do repointing and roof cleaning?

Yes, both are on our van alongside roofing. Repointing and roof cleaning.

Where We Work

Where are you based?

Lancaster, in the LA3 postcode area. Roofers in Lancaster.

Which areas do you cover?

Lancaster, Morecambe, Preston, Blackpool, Barrow-in-Furness, Ulverston, Kendal, Leyland, Chorley, Southport, Wigan, Bolton and Manchester, and more widely Lancashire, Cumbria and Yorkshire. Every area we cover.

Do you cover the villages around the towns?

Yes. Around Lancaster that's Morecambe, Heysham, Bare, Halton, Carnforth and Garstang, and the areas page lists the villages around each town. If yours isn't there, ask.

Getting a Quote

How do I get a quote?

Call 07734 356942, message us on WhatsApp, email stormwiseroofing1@gmail.com or fill in the quote form.

Can I send you photos of the roof?

Yes. WhatsApp them to 07734 356942 with your town or postcode and a line on what's wrong.

How soon can you start?

It depends on the diary and the weather at the time. Ask when you call and we'll tell you where we are.

Still Got a Question?

Ask Lewis directly, by phone or on WhatsApp.
